flow_summary: The interview maintains a logical sequence and mostly asks one question at a time, with good handling of repeatable items (medications, family history, jobs) by checking for additional entries. However, it repeats a question already answered clearly in past_psychiatric_history and uses an abrupt yes/no redirect on a nuanced family-history response.

issues.evidence: After patient states 'Yes, I was assessed back in 2021 by Dr. Harold Blyth', interviewer immediately asks 'When were you assessed, and by whom?'
After patient hedges 'I think my dad has obsessive-compulsive traits...', interviewer says 'Please answer yes or no.'

field_verdicts.produced: It’s on Sherbourne Street in Toronto — do you want the full line with the apartment details too?

field_verdicts.note: missing handwashing detail, frequency, and work impact
field_verdicts.expected: Contamination fears and repeated handwashing; checking the stove and door locks up to thirty times before leaving; about three hours each day; late for work most mornings.
field_verdicts.produced: Mostly contamination fears and a lot of checking — like the stove and the door locks. It’s taking up a few hours a day.

field_verdicts.expected: Cut down the checking; get to work on time; stop the hand washing hurting my skin.
field_verdicts.produced: I’d like to cut down the checking and get to work on time, and also stop my hands from getting so sore.

field_verdicts.expected: 2021; DR. HAROLD BLYTH, psychiatrist; assessed for obsessive-compulsive symptoms.
field_verdicts.produced: In 2021, by Dr. Harold Blyth, a psychiatrist.

field_verdicts.expected: Cognitive behavioural therapy; 2021; approximately 16 sessions; hospital outpatient clinic
field_verdicts.produced: Yes — I had cognitive behavioural therapy before.; I think it was in 2021.; About 16 sessions, give or take.

field_verdicts.expected: Exposure and response prevention; 2023; approximately 10 sessions; private practice.
field_verdicts.produced: Yes — I had cognitive behavioural therapy before.; I think it was in 2021.; About 16 sessions, give or take.

field_verdicts.expected: Fluvoxamine; 150 mg nightly; started March 2023; drowsiness in the morning
field_verdicts.produced:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Fluvoxamine.; Dose: 150 mg nightly.; Start Or Duration: Started around March 2023.; Side Effects: It makes me drowsy in the morning.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes — there was one before, sertraline.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: About 8 months in 2021.; Side Effects: I don’t remember any side effects from it.

field_verdicts.expected: Sertraline; 100 mg daily; about 8 months in 2021; stopped for limited benefit
field_verdicts.produced: Past medication 1: Name Or Description: Sertraline.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Dates Or Duration: I took it for about 8 months in 2021.; Discontinuation Reason: It was stopped because it didn’t help enough.

field_verdicts.expected: Father; obsessive-compulsive traits; never formally diagnosed.
field_verdicts.produced: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My father.; Diagnosis Or Condition: Obsessive-compulsive traits.; Additional Details: No, that’s all I know.

field_verdicts.expected: Previous; cigarettes; about 10 per day; 3 years
field_verdicts.produced: Status: Previous; Substance or product: Cigarettes.; Quantity or frequency: About 10 cigarettes a day.; Duration: For about 3 years.

field_verdicts.expected: Data analyst, Ridgeway Insurance; 2021 to present
field_verdicts.produced: Job 1: Name Or Description: Ridgeway Insurance.; Job Title: Data analyst.; Dates: 2021 to present.

field_verdicts.expected: Born in Lagos; moved to Toronto at age 7; described as a careful, orderly child.
field_verdicts.produced: I was born in Lagos and moved to Toronto when I was 7. I was a careful, orderly kid.

field_verdicts.expected: Strong student; began checking rituals around age 19 during university.
field_verdicts.produced: I was a strong student, and the checking stuff started around age 19, during university.

field_verdicts.note: missing closeness to mother and sister
field_verdicts.expected: Single; close to his mother and younger sister.
field_verdicts.produced: I’m single, so nothing major there.

field_verdicts.expected: Manage the rituals well enough to live independently without them.
field_verdicts.produced: I want to get the rituals under control well enough to live independently without them.
